intro.title: RESTOCK THE OCEAN, FEED THE FUTURE
intro.caption: Shedding light on the systemic impact of intensive aquaculture, and more specifically on salmon consumption.
intro.imageAlt: School of fish surfing a wave

ambition.origin: PinkBombs was born from a simple ambition: to shed light on the systemic impact of intensive aquaculture, and more specifically on salmon consumption.
ambition.paragraph: Driven by Seastemik in collaboration with DataForGood, PinkBombs establishes itself as the reference barometer, offering a transparent and documented view of the ecological, health, and ethical issues related to fish production and consumption. More than just an alert platform, it is a true decision-making tool designed for citizens, businesses, and public decision-makers. Our mission is clear: to support the transition towards ocean-friendly food. Because 'de-fishing' our plates means restocking the ocean and feeding the future.

situation.title: Situation
situation.paragraph: We are facing an ocean emergency. The ocean, the main source of life on Earth, is increasingly threatened by our human activities. Overfishing is the main cause of marine biodiversity loss. The salmon industry, emblematic of intensive aquaculture, generates multiple impacts on a global scale. It is therefore urgent to change the food system for better protection of humans, animals, and ecosystems.

reaction.title: Reaction
reaction.imageAlt: Happy fish looking to the future
reaction.paragraph:
PinkBombs is here to:
  • Alert about one of the greatest threats to the ocean today: salmon farming.
  • Deconstruct the distorted popular perception around salmon consumption.
  • Guide businesses, states, and consumers towards positive solutions.

seastemik.title: Seastemik
seastemik.paragraph: Seastemik is an NGO founded in 2023 that is committed to a living Ocean through a systemic revolution of our food. We work to end unsustainable aquaculture practices, particularly intensive salmon farming, for better protection of humans, animals, and ecosystems.

dataforgood.title: DataForGood
dataforgood.paragraph:
Data For Good is a non-profit association created in 2014 that brings together a community of 7,000+ tech volunteers (Data Scientists, Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Developers, UX/UI Designers, Product & Project Owners) who want to engage for the public interest.

Each year we work with about fifteen associations to co-construct projects that promote social justice, democracy, and the environment. We have thus supported, accelerated, and co-constructed more than 100 projects over the past 10 years.

We are also strong critics of the risks and abuses of technology. Being part of the community also means committing to sober technology that respects social and environmental issues and accepting that technology is not the solution to all problems.

partner.title: Partner
partner.paragraph:
This project was realized with the support of KRESK 4 OCEANS.

KRESK 4 OCEANS is an endowment fund created by the KRESK Group and its brands (SVR and Lazartigue) with the aim of creating projects and financing non-profit organizations that actively fight against marine pollution.

story.title: Story
story.paragraph: In 2023, we launched the first version of Pinkbombs, which received significant media coverage and advanced the cause. Our data was used by the newspaper Le Monde to publish an article by Les Décodeurs on the impact of salmon farming. Link to the article here. Since then, the information has been picked up by a series of media outlets such as Les Bon Potes, Brut, France Inter, and TV platforms like the 1 PM news on TF1, thus raising collective awareness about the impacts of the salmon industry.

method.title: Approach and Methodology
method.caption: PinkBombs was created to analyze and transform public data into tools accessible to everyone.

values.title: Our approach is based on three values:
items: Open source: The data is available on the platform.
Collaborative: Contact us to contribute or suggest improvements.
Dynamic: Our database is regularly updated to incorporate new perspectives and improve its accuracy.

steps.title: Our approach followed three steps :
items: Identification of priority topics: Since the site's goal is to provide a compilation of the most striking information on the subject, the organization began by prioritizing the topics to be addressed.
In-depth research: Documentary research was conducted on the Internet and by contacting experts, taking care to use only scientific sources or those from renowned international organizations.
Peer-reviewed data: In the interest of data quality, all information was internally verified. Support from experts allowed for final validation.

contact.title: Contact
contact.paragraph: Seastemik dreams of an Ocean teeming with life, preserved by a plant-based diet, ensuring the habitability of our planet: climate stability, human health, food justice, and animal welfare.
